purpose: Deterministic 0-10 ESTIMATED overall-destination score for published records without verified editorial rating evidence. Measures overall destination VALUE, not seasonal suitability (a highly seasonal destination must not be penalized for having one ideal season).
neverUses: ratings vector (gated by ratingMetadata; low/missing confidence means the raw numbers are unverified)
season vector (seasonal suitability is a separate dimension, never an overall score)
popularity rankings, user-review averages, or a source's existence as quality

inputs.scoring: importance tier: major 9 / notable 7 / standard 5 / minor 3 (unknown 5); +1 UNESCO world heritage (collectionId unesco-japan); +1 national treasure / important cultural property tag; +1 top-100-castle / three-great tag; clamped 1-10
inputs.rationale: A destination's national/international standing is the primary driver of overall value for a traveller deciding what to see.
inputs.missingInputBehavior: importance absent -> neutral 5; no heritage tags -> no bonus

inputs.scoring: UNESCO world heritage (unesco-japan) -> 8; national park / Japan heritage / world heritage tag or national-parks-japan collection -> 7; any other collection membership or prefectural-heritage tag -> 6; none -> 4
inputs.rationale: Third-party designations (UNESCO, national parks, heritage programmes) are independent recognition of quality.
inputs.missingInputBehavior: no collections/tags -> 4 (absence of designation is evidence of absence)

inputs.scoring: distinct category count >=4 -> 8, 2-3 -> 6, 1 -> 4; +1 for >=3 highlights, +0.5 for 1-2; +0.5 when indoorPercent 20-80 (balanced indoor/outdoor); clamped 1-10
inputs.rationale: Depth and variety of things to see/do is a core value dimension; extreme single-focus or single-environment places are lower.
inputs.missingInputBehavior: empty categories -> 4; no highlights -> no bonus; indoorPercent absent -> no balance bonus

inputs.scoring: finite transport modes >=3 -> 8, 1-2 -> 6, 0 -> 3; +1 with recommendedVisitHours; +0.5 with finite walkingMin; clamped 1-10
inputs.rationale: A destination a traveller can actually reach and plan is worth more; pure accessibility, low weight.
inputs.missingInputBehavior: no transport modes -> 3; missing visit window / walking data -> no bonus

inputs.scoring: base 5; +1.5 with officialWebsite; +1.5 status verified, +0.5 status published; clamped 1-10
inputs.rationale: Evidence maturity — official sources and catalogue status signal how trustworthy the record's facts are (never quality by itself; low weight).
inputs.missingInputBehavior: no officialWebsite -> no bonus; unknown status -> base 5

missingCompositeBehavior: every component has a documented neutral fallback, so ANY Destination-shaped record scores (published target: 0 unavailable). A record with no rubric inputs at all scores 5 (documented neutral), never null.
versioning: bump rubricVersion on any input/weight/scoring change; the basis note in the UI and the score-state audit must reference this version.
provenance: component inputs are existing catalogue fields with their own KAI-89 provenance (fieldSources / *Metadata); the rubric itself is the calculated layer (state estimated, confidence low, modelVersion kai-89-overall-v1).
